purpose: Identify something with a very polite copula.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Noun / な-adjective + でございます.
The charge is one thousand yen.
formation: Noun / な-adjective + でございます.
restrictions: It raises the politeness of the statement rather than honoring the subject by itself.
mistake: It does not attach directly after an い-adjective in the same way.
